% ---------------------------------------------------------------- Figure 1 --
\begin{figure*}[t]\centering
  \includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{figures/model_panel}
  \caption{The FISH model, on a hand-drawn fragment.
    \textbf{(a)}~the fully expanded graph: the containment hierarchy from the
    host down to the individual callbacks, with colour marking the namespace a
    vertex belongs to and the edges being the containment relation of
    Sec.~\ref{sec:model}.
    \textbf{(b)}~how communication edges move up the layers: the two edges
    marked \circled{2} carry the very same message, so at the node and process
    layers they are one edge that aggregates the set; state and polled edges
    whose two endpoints sit inside the same node stay where they are and are
    never lifted.
    \textbf{(c)}~the trace patterns each edge is decided from, next to the
    model object they produce --- the same events give a \emph{candidate} join
    one row and the join itself in the next, once the test of
    Sec.~\ref{sec:model} holds.
    \textbf{(d)}~for a GPU-submitting callback FISH keeps \emph{every}
    execution as a typed DAG, groups the executions into shapes, and folds the
    shapes into one conditional graph: a skeleton common to all executions plus
    the branches, each with the share of executions that take it.}
  \label{fig:model}
\end{figure*}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- Figure 2 --
\begin{figure*}[t]\centering
  \includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{figures/results_panel}
  \caption{(Zoomed) screenshots from the FISH-eye visualisation stack operating
    on the FISH model.
    \textbf{(a)}~namespace grouping of a full Autoware rosbag replay: every
    namespace with its ROS nodes, callbacks, GPU-submitting callbacks, internal
    hops and state reads, and one aggregated edge per direction whose width is
    the number of messages it carries.
    \textbf{(b)}~a gantt view of the callbacks of the application, grouped into
    their executors and nodes, together with the metadata of each execution.
    \textbf{(c)}~part of the node-layer expansion of the \texttt{unet} benchmark
    of the \texttt{ros2\_benchmark} suite.
    For \texttt{occupancy\_grid\_map\_node $\leftarrow$
    sub:/perception/obstacle\_segmentation/single\_frame/pointcloud} of
    Autoware: \textbf{(d)}~conditional graph over its 238 executions and
    \textbf{(e)}~the full typed DAG of a single execution.}
  \label{fig:results}
\end{figure*}
